livestock_count.limitation: Field enumeration by cooperative field agent. Not independently verified. Encumbrance not established by this count.

livestock_valuation.limitation: Cooperative-stated total. Valuation method not independently verified. Source: cooperative officer self-assessment.

livestock_valuation.method: Not recorded. Cooperative total stated without per-animal or market-reference basis.
livestock_valuation.scope: Total ZMW 420,000 stated as cooperative-level valuation. Not derived from count × unit price in this record.

livestock_encumbrance.limitation: Reported unencumbered by cooperative officers. Registry check not performed. Encumbrance status is asserted, not verified.

cases.members_roster_note: Partial sample of 4 members shown for demonstration. The cooperative has 74 members total. The other 70 members' livestock is not represented in this sample roster and must not be used to infer the cooperative's full livestock inventory.
